dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Telekinesis was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. During her time in care, Telekinesis has shown fearful and defensive behavior around handling, including head whipping with a tense body and face, and escalating to hard barking and snapping at staff during medical examination. Due to levels of fear and stress, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Telekinesis
